name: B10-0052/2024 (Renew) – The severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
title: Resolution on the severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the immediate release of all political prisoners in Belarus and payment of compensation to them. It asks for stronger sanctions on the Lukashenka regime, including on officials responsible for human rights abuses and on goods made with forced prison labour. It wants those responsible held to account, including through a possible International Criminal Court case. It also asks the European Union to support Belarusians who have fled, for example with visas and residence permits.

- The Parliament asks for sanctions and releases; nothing changes yet.
- It affects Belarusian officials, prisoners and Belarusians abroad.
- Next, the Council and EU countries decide on sanctions and visas.
